'''Xist's fortress'''<ref name="CSWE Xist">{{CSWECite|III|342-343|Xist}}</ref> was a [[Fortress/Legends|fortified]] compound located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[New Coronet]],<ref name="Obsession 1">[[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]]</ref> the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trigalis/Legends|Trigalis]].<ref name="CSWE Trigalis">{{CSWECite|III|263|Trigalis}}</ref> The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] enforcer [[Xist]] controlled New Coronet<ref name="CSWE Xist" /> from inside the fortress.<ref name="Obsession 1" />
